udp_enabled.description:
Enable UDP functionality (UDP ASSOCIATE and UDP-over-TCP).
When false (default), UDP ASSOCIATE returns "command not supported".

fallback.description:
Fallback destination for failed authentication (optional)
When set, failed auth attempts are proxied here instead of rejected

zero_rtt_handshake.description:
Enable 0-RTT (0.5-RTT for server) handshake for faster connection establishment.
Default is false for security - 0-RTT data is vulnerable to replay attacks.
See: https://blog.cloudflare.com/even-faster-connection-establishment-with-quic-0-rtt-resumption/

oneOf.description:
Mixed HTTP+SOCKS5 server (auto-detects protocol from first byte)
Similar to mihomo's mixed-port feature.

oneOf.description:
NaiveProxy server (HTTP/2 CONNECT with padding)

Fallback for probe resistance (optional)
Can be either a URL (http:// or https://) to reverse proxy, or an absolute path to serve files from

max_udp_queued_bytes.description: Shared outbound payload allowance across session and destination queues.

VlessEncryptionSetting.description: Exportable configuration credential, never included in diagnostic output.

vision.description:
Enable XTLS-Vision protocol for TLS-in-TLS optimization.
When enabled, the inner protocol MUST be VLESS.
Vision detects TLS-in-TLS scenarios and switches to Direct mode for zero-copy performance.
Requires TLS 1.3.

private_key.description: X25519 private key (32 bytes, base64url encoded)

short_ids.description: List of valid short IDs (hex strings, 0-16 chars each)

cipher_suites.description:
TLS 1.3 cipher suites to support (optional)
Valid values: "TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256", "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384", "TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256"
If empty or not specified, the default set is used.

vision.description:
Enable XTLS-Vision protocol for TLS-in-TLS optimization.
When enabled, the inner protocol MUST be VLESS.
Vision detects TLS-in-TLS scenarios and switches to Direct mode for zero-copy performance.
Reality provides censorship resistance while Vision provides performance optimization.

dest_client_chain.description:
Client chain for connecting to dest server (for fallback connections).
If not specified, connects directly to dest.

resolve_hostname.description:
When true, resolve hostnames to IP addresses before passing to HTTP CONNECT.
Used when the upstream proxy blocks by hostname.

cipher_suites.description:
TLS 1.3 cipher suites to use (optional)
Valid values: "TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256", "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384", "TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256"
If empty or not specified, all three cipher suites are offered.

vision.description:
Enable XTLS-Vision protocol for TLS-in-TLS optimization.

padding_scheme.description:
Custom padding scheme (optional, uses default if not specified)
Each line is a key=value pair like "stop=8" or "0=30-30"

idle_session_check_interval_secs.description: Values <= 5 use the reference default of 30 seconds.

min_idle_session.description: Retention floor, not proactive dialing or a connection limit.

H2MuxConfig.description:
Configuration for h2mux (HTTP/2 multiplexing) on protocols that support it.

H2MUX multiplexes multiple proxy streams over a single HTTP/2 connection,
reducing connection overhead and improving performance for many concurrent streams.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of connections to maintain

min_streams.description: Minimum number of streams before opening a new connection

max_streams.description: Maximum number of streams per connection (0 = unlimited)

kcp_settings.title: KcpSettings
kcp_settings.description: Validated KCP settings shared by client and server configurations.

DnsServerSpec.description: A DNS server specification in config.

anyOf.description:
Simple URL string: "system", "udp://8.8.8.8", etc.
Must be IP-based (no hostnames). Cannot have bootstrap_url.
Object with URL and optional client_chain, bootstrap_url, server_name, ip_strategy.

bootstrap_url.description:
Bootstrap resolver for hostname resolution.
Can be a URL string (e.g., "udp://8.8.8.8") or a dns_group name.

server_name.description: SNI server name override for TLS/HTTPS. Defaults to hostname from URL.

ip_strategy.description: IP lookup strategy for DNS resolution. Defaults to ipv4_then_ipv6.

timeout_secs.description: Timeout for DNS resolution in seconds. Defaults to 5. Set to 0 to disable.

connect_timeout_secs.description:
Timeout for establishing connections to DNS upstreams in seconds.
Defaults to 5. Separate from timeout_secs which covers the full request.
For plain `tcp://` upstreams, hickory also passes the request timeout
into `connect_tcp`, so the runtime uses the shorter of that value and
this connect timeout.

attempts.description: Number of retry attempts for failed queries. Defaults to 1.

native_cache_secs.description: Fixed OS/NSS lookup memoization window. System only; omitted or 0 disables it.

IpStrategy.description: IP lookup strategy for DNS resolution.

oneOf.description: Query A and AAAA in parallel.
Query A first, fall back to AAAA (default).
Query AAAA first, fall back to A.
